These days I couldn't say that one particular album is myfavorite, different days and different moods equal different albums. But back in the day I was very fond of The Final Cut. I know it's not on many top ten list, but I connected with it. It was really kind of a Roger Waters solo album with the Floyd as a backing band , and it was their last album together. It was kind of like they didn't want to be together but they did it for the sake of the songs. Like a couple staying together for the kids. With Richard Wright bowing out,it was more guitar driven, with producer Michael Kamen stepping in to add keyboards as needed. It followed the themes of the wall and basically finished the story that the wall started. It was a great closure to the story and a great closure to the classic Pink Floyd line up.
There's so many awesome ones. How can you pick just one!? On this album alone there's a bunch of insane shit like Echoes and One of These Days.

Yeah I know, it is hard to pick one, and when I listen to floyd I really just listen to the entire album, not one song,. But back in 1994 I went to see PF in concert, the Division Bell tour, and in those days you actually waited in line for a 20-30 hours for tickets to a show like this.Long day, great night of partying with strangers, young and old,but in the morning a couple hours before tickets went on sale we had to queue up in line, a spontaneous sing along of Fearless broke out, and a hundred tired and worn out strangers harmonized perfectly . I guess the closest comparison would be like the Tiny Dancer seen in Almost Famous. I will always have fond memories of that and this song will always stick out because of that.
